item.title: Kashmir in grip of cold wave, Shopian coldest place at – 8.6 °C
item.description: Srinagar: Cold wave conditions in Kashmir intensified as minimum temperature settled several degrees below freezing point, officials said on Sunday. The sub-zero temperature and clear skies resulted in the freezing of parts of the Dal Lake and other water bodies. Srinagar recorded a minimum temperature of minus 5.2 degrees Celsius on Saturday night, slight up from the previous night’s minus 5.7 degrees Celsius. item.title: Preparations for census 2027 initiated in J&K
item.description: NAVVNEET DUBEY Jammu: Jammu & Kashmir is preparing for the Census 2027, with a Union Territory-level Census Coordination Committee set to determine a 30-day window for house listing operations (HLO) between April 1 and September 30. item.title: Forces opposing Somnath rebuilding still active, need to defeat them, says PM Modi
item.description: Gujarat: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday said the forces that had opposed the reconstruction of the Somnath temple after independence are “still active among us”, and India needs to be alert, united and strong to defeat them. Referring to the attacks endured by the historic temple, located in Gujarat’s Gir Somnath district, in the past and how it was rebuilt every time, Modi said the hearts of people can never be won at the point of a sword. item.title: Jammu-Srinagar Highway, Mughal Road Open; Traffic moves freely
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 13: Traffic movement on the Jammu Srinagar National Highway remained smooth on Tuesday, with the vital road link staying open for both light motor vehicles and heavy motor vehicles. Officials said vehicular movement was reported to be normal from both Jammu and Srinagar sides, with no major congestion or disruption observed along the highway. item.title: GPS Tracking Mandated for Mineral Extraction Vehicles in South Kashmir district
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 13: The District Mineral Office, Shopian has issued directions mandating the installation of AIS-140 approved GPS tracking devices on all vehicles and machinery engaged in mineral extraction and transportation within the district.
